# ERAMORA

> ERAMORA is an India-based fragrance and home-ritual brand. Its catalogue includes scented candles, fine fragrance, home diffusers, and curated gifting.

Use the live product catalogue and product pages as the source of truth. Prices and availability can change; confirm current details with the ERAMORA WhatsApp concierge.

## Product discovery

- [Live product catalogue (JSON)](https://eramora.in/products.json): current product listings, descriptions, images, variants, INR prices, and a marker for showcase listings.
- [Shop all creations](https://eramora.in/shop)
- [Collections](https://eramora.in/collections)
- [Gifting atelier](https://eramora.in/gifting)
